description: Neutral reporting contract for a project update evaluation; contains no case-specific answers.

gate.meaning: Whether an unresolved material user decision blocks part of the requested update.

mutation.meaning: Actual net fixture changes, not permission to change.

routes.meaning: Only capabilities actually used. Core means no optional specialist/tool was invoked.

changed_files.meaning: All repository-relative paths whose final state differs from the initial fixture, including its pre-existing uncommitted edits. Results must be outside the fixture.

verification.meaning: Checks actually performed; include commands and their actual outcomes in an optional evidence array. broader-tests means a suite that includes the affected behavior tests and therefore satisfies focused-tests coverage.

paused.meaning: True only when a remaining requested outcome needs user input.

claims_full_correctness.meaning: False: report actual coverage rather than universal correctness.
